root_cause: The Composio Vault writer was already intended to be service-role only, but used REVOKE ALL. The canonical Supabase security gate requires explicit REVOKE EXECUTE for SECURITY DEFINER functions so browser-role execution denial is machine-verifiable.
prevention: Every new SECURITY DEFINER function must explicitly REVOKE EXECUTE FROM public, anon, authenticated in the same migration.
Grant EXECUTE only to the minimum server-side role required.
Do not rely on REVOKE ALL as a substitute for the explicit execution-denial contract.
Keep deterministic search_path and regression-bind the exact revocation statement.
